hero.description: I craft modern, scalable, and performant web applications using the MERN stack. Passionate about clean code, intuitive UI/UX, and building products that make a difference.

about.title: Turning Ideas Into Digital Reality
about.bio1: I'm a dedicated MERN Full Stack Developer with a passion for creating elegant, efficient, and user-centric web applications. With a strong foundation in both frontend and backend technologies, I bridge the gap between design and functionality.
about.bio2: My approach combines clean code principles with modern design patterns, ensuring every project is scalable, maintainable, and delivers an exceptional user experience.

experience.desc: Leading a team of 5 developers building enterprise SaaS products. Architected microservices backend serving 50K+ daily users. Reduced API response time by 40% through optimization and caching strategies.

Built and maintained 10+ client-facing web applications. Implemented real-time features using Socket.io. Integrated third-party APIs including Stripe, Twilio, and SendGrid for payment and communication solutions.

Developed responsive websites and web applications for diverse clients. Collaborated with designers to translate Figma mockups into pixel-perfect code. Gained expertise in RESTful API design and database management.
Started my professional journey building UI components with React. Learned agile methodologies and version control best practices. Contributed to improving site performance and accessibility scores.
